## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` - new feature (minor bump)
- [ ] `fix` - bug fix (patch bump)
- [ ] `docs` - documentation (patch bump)
- [ ] `chore` - release/signing/infra/dependency work (major bump)
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` / `ci` - maintenance (patch bump unless breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!` / `BREAKING CHANGE`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off `dev`
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (drives the release version bump)
- [ ] `dart format lib test` clean
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean
- [ ] `flutter test` passing
- [ ] No secrets / `.env` / certs committed
